title: Planning Board Public Hearing
text: TOWN OF SUNDERLAND Office of Planning Board NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING The Planning Board of the Town of Sunderland will hold a public hearing at 7:00 PM, Tuesday, January 12, 2027, in the Sunderland Town Offices, for zoning amendments to Code of Sunderland by inserting a floodplain overlay district. Floodplains and floodways are mentioned in §125 (IIT) (3) (C) and (D). FRCOG recommends deleting those sub-sections and replacing them with the applicable model bylaw language in §125(II) - establishing a new special resource district -- under a new section (D). However, where the floodplain district language best fits into the Sunderland Zoning Bylaws is the discretion of the Planning Board. The complete text of the proposed bylaw is on file with the Town Clerk and is available for inspection by interested parties during regular business Hours. Dana Roscoe Chairman, Sunderland Planning Board
